senadores_actuales.json.note: Kept in the repository and not shipped in the release bundle: no step reads it, and it carries each serving senator's office e-mail, phone extension and social-media links.

bloques_por_fecha.csv.note: one roll-call record per sitting date; each lists the whole chamber with the caucus each senator sat in that day

bloque_por_foto.csv.note: the Senate's own bloc-roster page, recovered from the Internet Archive because the page no longer exists and the Senate keeps no copy; one row per senator per capture, names exactly as printed. A capture dates the page, not the chamber.

bloque_por_ficha.csv.note: the Senate's own per-senator pages, recovered from the Internet Archive; each states the senator's caucus ('Bloque: ...'). One row per page per capture, names exactly as printed, with the address of the capture it rests on. A capture dates the page, not the chamber.

authorities_manual.csv.note: Senate authorities and national-executive officers whose terms fall between 1995 and 2026 (presidencia, presidencia provisional, vicepresidencias, secretarias, prosecretarias); the executive officers are those observed as speakers. No open-data endpoint exists for authorities; compiled from the designation/ratification passages of the held stenographic transcripts (source_url per row) and senado.gob.ar/autoridades.

reuse_terms.finding: The Senate open-data portal (https://www.senado.gob.ar/micrositios/DatosAbiertos/) publishes no dataset license or terms-of-use page; datos.gob.ar does not carry these datasets. The Senate transparency office page (https://www.senado.gob.ar/micrositios/oficinatransparencia) cites Ley 27.275 (plus Decretos 206/17 and 780/24) as its marco normativo.
operative_quotes: Art. 1 (Apertura): 'la información debe ser accesible en formatos electrónicos abiertos, que faciliten su procesamiento por medios automáticos que permitan su reutilización o su redistribución por parte de terceros'
Art. 1 (Gratuidad): 'el acceso a la información debe ser gratuito'
Art. 32 (Transparencia activa): '...procurando remover toda barrera que obstaculice o dificulte su reutilización por parte de terceros'
